title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省拉瓦格市本卡格描笼涯至巴卡拉市镇布永描笼涯的绕行公路命名为Rodolfo G. Farinas, Jr.绕行公路的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the By-Pass Road Stretching From Barangay Bengcag, City of Laoag, to Barangay Buyon, Municipality of Bacarra, Province of Ilocos Norte, as the Rodolfo G. Farinas, Jr. By-Pass Road
title.orig: An Act Naming the By-Pass Road Stretching From Barangay Bengcag, City of Laoag, to Barangay Buyon, Municipality of Bacarra, Province of Ilocos Norte, as the Rodolfo G. Farinas, Jr. By-Pass Road

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11034_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The by-pass road stretching from Barangay Bengcag, City of Laoag, To Barangay Buyon, Municipality of Bacarra, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby named as the Rodolfo G. Fariñas, Jr. By=Pass Road.

The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) shall include in their annual budget the funds necessary for the implementation of this Act including installation and maintenance of signages thereat.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
